title: angular-django2 typed Material form-field schematic
description: Generate a standalone OnPush typed ControlValueAccessor Material form field.

name.description: Kebab-case name for the form-field component. Required unless --document is given; defaults to the node [name] attribute or id.

path.description: Destination directory within the selected application's source root.

project.description: Target application project. Required when more than one application is available.

controlType.description: Native control kind: text, email, password, number, or textarea. Defaults to text. Not allowed with --document.

appearance.description: Angular Material form-field appearance. Defaults to fill. Not allowed with --document.

subscriptSizing.description: Angular Material hint and error subscript sizing. Defaults to fixed. Not allowed with --document.

document.description: Workspace-relative path to a canonical OpenUI JSON document (*.openui.json or *.json). Compiles a TextInputs or RangeControl node; [type], [appearance], and [subscriptSizing] come from the node.

nodeId.description: Optional element ID within the OpenUI document to compile. When omitted, targets the first element of a supported type. Requires --document.
